name: org.d20dao/vrf
title: D20DAO Verifiable Randomness
description: Verifiable VRF draws on Arc, 0.05 USDC each. On Robinhood Chain, integrate on chain with the SDK.

environmentVariables.name: D20_DAILY_LIMIT_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Spending cap per UTC day in USDC (default 1; 0 turns paid draws off).

environmentVariables.name: D20_PAY_CHAIN
environmentVariables.description: Circle CLI chain code to pay from, such as ARC or BASE (default: first funded).

environmentVariables.name: D20_WALLET_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Agent wallet to pay from (default: the first one the Circle CLI lists).

environmentVariables.name: D20_CIRCLE_CLI
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Circle CLI's dist/index.js (default: circle on PATH).

environmentVariables.name: D20_MCP_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Folder for the daily spending record (default ~/.d20dao-mcp).
